jamie-peopleops: Quick thread: a couple managers asked about off-cycle promotions, appeals after calibration, and comp compression fixes. Dropping the ground rules here.

carmen-dir: For appeals after calibration, what's the timeline? Can managers reopen a case?

jamie-peopleops: Short: you can file a post-calibration appeal within 10 business days with new evidence (impact docs, customer metrics, peer feedback). We'll convene a small panel (People Ops + 2 directors) and respond within 7 business days.

raj-eng: Is this different from the "comp committee" review path?

jamie-peopleops: Yes. Appeals are for cases where calibration overlooked scope/impact. Comp committee is for >15% increases or exceptions (band breach). Appeals usually don't change comp bands unless committee agrees.

natalie-ic: What about pay compression where a junior IC already makes close to a promoted peer? Any guardrails?

jamie-peopleops: We prefer to adjust the promoted person's comp to preserve internal equity and band logic. If compression would cause budget issues, we may suggest an equity refresh or phased increase. Always include market data in the packet.

carmen-dir: Phased increases = what cadence?

jamie-peopleops: Typical phased plan is 60% at promotion, 40% at next quarter or 6 months, with manager + finance sign-off. We document in the offer memo and include review date.

raj-eng: Equity implications? Do off-cycle promos get immediate refresh?

jamie-peopleops: Off-cycle promotions are eligible for equity refresh, but approval is case-by-case. Standard practice: if promotion materially changes level/responsibility, include an equity recommendation (grant size rationale, vesting schedule) in the packet.

natalie-ic: If manager and director disagree on level, does People Ops pick?

jamie-peopleops: We mediate. First try to resolve between manager and director. If unresolved, People Ops escalates to calibration lead who makes the final call for that cycle. Document dissent in notes.

carmen-dir: Any special rules for managers being promoted into an open headcount vs creating a new role?

jamie-peopleops: If promo fills an open req, ensure recruiting/people ops do headcount transfer in Workday before effective date. New role creations need org approval + compensation sign-off.

raj-eng: Retroactive raises — allowed?

jamie-peopleops: Retro pay only if approval is before payroll cutoff for the effective month. Otherwise effective date is next month start. Finance must approve retro exception; rare case.

payroll-bot: FYI: Payroll cutoff for March cycle is 2026-03-20 23:59 UTC.

natalie-ic: For documentation, what should I attach to make the packet fast?

jamie-peopleops: Minimal required files: 1) 1-paragraph role summary 2) 2 impact examples with metrics 3) current comp and requested comp + market comps 4) manager + director sign-off screenshot or note 5) equity recommendation if any. Use our template: https://confluence.redwood/people/promo-packet.

carmen-dir: One last Q: do we publish promotion criteria to ICs?

jamie-peopleops: We publish leveling guidelines + examples for each band. Promotions themselves are manager-led and confidential until announcement. If you want a group Q&A, people ops can host a manager drop-in next week.

raj-eng: Cool, thanks. I'll prep the packet for Rhea.

jamie-peopleops: Happy to review drafts — DM me with the packet.
